name: Send Message
summary: Start a new outbound message to someone on Telegram or WhatsApp.
description:
Opens a new outbound conversation through a channel. `channel` is inferred when the agent is already messaging from a Telegram or WhatsApp chat; otherwise provide it explicitly.

`content` is sent verbatim as the message body.

params.name: channel
params.description: Channel to send through. Inferred from the current chat when possible.

params.name: target
params.description: Recipient address (Telegram chat id or WhatsApp JID).
